/usr/bin/systemctl show --property=LoadState,UnitFileState,ActiveState -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl show --property=LoadState,UnitFileState,ActiveState -- nginx
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /usr/bin/apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install curl
/usr/bin/systemctl show --timestamp=unix --property=ActiveState,ExecMainStartTimestamp -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl daemon-reload
/usr/bin/systemctl show --timestamp=unix --property=ActiveState,ExecMainStartTimestamp -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl show --timestamp=unix --property=ActiveState,ExecMainStartTimestamp -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl enable -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl start -- k3s
/usr/bin/systemctl start -- nginx
